notes.title: EONA will be present at Gamescom 2025!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45700900/ff7e5044067e1a1c8ef49c3968017d73c057fadd.jpg"]SUPER AC is proud to announce its presence at Gamescom in Cologne, Germany, this year, from August 20th to 24th, Hall 10.1, Booth B.091. 


At our booth, visitors will be able to try out: 

PROHIBEAST, 

EONA, 

CINESCAPE VR, 

and SKY LEGENDS, an aeropostal epic. 

Come to meet the development teams and have a great time with us.

We look forward to see you there. 



PS: Free goodies for everyone who finishes the demo!

THE SUPER AC TEAM
